rootNamedRepairs.resolution: The independent reviewer accepted the circumcenter hypotenuse-midpoint primary. The author added the missing isosceles converse support and an exact IMPLIED quote for the equal-angle-to-equal-side step.

Preserve the dynamic area-function proposal and separate RPM leaf gap, with the physical time range and exact four-slot evidence.
